validation.browserEvidence: This batch passed 18 browser cases across all three engines: six whole-study scale cases, nine existing scale cases and three example autofit cases. Autofit expands when an extreme enters view and contracts when it leaves. Both new examples also ran on the built website, including all four scale controls. Screenshots were inspected; traffic uses fixtures rather than live brokers.
validation.budgetChange: Whole-study transactions, primitive scale binding and owned defaults increase base from 100.10 to 102.20 kB and chart-only from 59.62 to 61.71 KiB. Requested calculations increase the optional indicator tier from 32.74 to 33.59 kB. Limits are 102.25 kB base, 110.25 kB base plus trade, 33.75 kB indicators, 236.75 kB terminal, 276.25 kB all tiers and 61.75 KiB chart-only. Other optional-tier budgets are unchanged and removal checks pass.
validation.review: Independent review checked scale transactions, shared/manual ownership, restoration, formatter order and atomic axis refusal. Requested-context helpers passed 63 tests and 12000 independent comparisons across 4000 snapshots. Full-suite regressions exposed unplotted fill columns and comparison projections being mistaken for manual host ranges; both were corrected and the complete suite passed.
validation.packageVerification: Verify passed lint, typecheck, 6725 unit tests, seven endurance-harness checks, build, 424 example tests and declaration identity. Measured feature growth required the documented budget adjustments; size and tree-shake checks then passed. Eleven compiled-program checks and public adapter typechecking passed.
